# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- Write clean, human readable and maintainable code,  that minimizes cognitive effort to understand.
	- Prefere "var height = complex_formula_1; var width = complex_formula_2; return height * width;" over "return complex_formula_1 * complex_formula_2;"
- When writing or reviewing code:
	- Consider performance while keeping solutions KISS and avoiding premature optimization. 
	- Use code documentation to understand context and intent, but do not update documentation comments unless if told to do so explicitly.
